preview: St Kitts & Nevis Patriots face Saint Lucia Kings in CPL 2026 Match 25 at Warner Park. The match is scheduled for Thu 3 Sep at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
